cases.name: Poseidon Wave Media LLC v. Suno, Inc.
UMG Recordings, Sony Music et al. v. Suno, Inc.

profile_text.body:
Suno is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in Cambridge, MA, that operates an AI music generation platform at suno.com. The company describes its service as an AI song generator capable of producing complete original songs, including vocals, lyrics, and full production, from a single text prompt in under a minute, across any genre. A free tier is available, while paid plans extend the offering: the Pro plan provides 500 songs per month, royalty-free music, commercial use rights, stem separation, and access to what the company calls its best model, v5.5, and the Premier plan provides 2,000 songs per month along with Suno Studio, which the company describes as a first-of-its-kind web-based generative audio workstation combining traditional DAW functionality with AI-powered creation, including a multitrack editor, MIDI export, and persona voices.

Suno faces substantial litigation. The most prominent case is UMG Recordings, Sony Music et al. v. Suno, Inc., filed in the District of Massachusetts, alongside seven additional suits in federal courts across Massachusetts, Texas, New York, and Illinois, brought by various individual and corporate plaintiffs including S.A. Jamendo and Poseidon Wave Media LLC. The site's held facts record 76 items of legal exposure under Massachusetts jurisdiction, and the product entry notes that IP provenance is a relevant consideration for the music generation service.
